sentences.en: BEN: The course feedback form?
sentences.zh: BEN: 是课程反馈表吗？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yes
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 对。

sentences.en: If you want, we it can do it together, I've got mine here
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以一起填，我的表格就在这儿。

sentences.en: BEN: Is that OK?
sentences.zh: BEN: 这样可以吗？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yeah
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 可以。

sentences.en: BEN: OK, let's have a look then
sentences.zh: BEN: 好吧，那我们来看看。

sentences.en: What do we have to do?
sentences.zh: 我们需要做些什么？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Let's fill in the top first, let's see, Course, Course code
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 我们先填顶部信息吧。来，看看：课程名称、课程代码……

sentences.en: BEN: Er, it's Communication in Business
sentences.zh: BEN: 嗯，是《商务沟通》。

sentences.en: ANNIE: OK, Communication. .. in
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 好的，《商务》……《沟通》……

sentences.en: Business, I do know that, but what's the code?
sentences.zh: 《商务沟通》，这个我知道，但课程代码是多少？

sentences.en: BEN: CB16 something, CB162, isn't it?
sentences.zh: BEN: CB16开头的某个编号，是CB162，对吧？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Mmm, that's it, OK and dates, when did we start?
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 嗯，对，就是它。好的，还有日期——我们是什么时候开始的？

sentences.en: I remember, my birthday's on May 4th and it was the day after, it must have been May 5th
sentences.zh: 我记得我的生日是5月4日，而开课日是次日，所以一定是5月5日。

sentences.en: BEN: Gosh, doesn't seem that long ago, does it?
sentences.zh: BEN: 天啊，感觉没过去那么久，是吧？

sentences.en: ANNIE: No, and we finish at the end of this week, on Friday, so that's July 15th?
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 是啊。而且我们这周五结课，也就是7月15日，对吧？

sentences.en: BEN: Er 16th, Monday was the 12th
sentences.zh: BEN: 嗯，是16号。周一那天是12号。

sentences.en: Right, that was the easy bit, now let's have a look - "Please give your comments on the following aspects of the course", OK, what's the first one?
sentences.zh: 好了，这部分很简单。现在我们来看下一项：‘请就以下课程各方面发表您的意见’。好，第一项是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, course organisation
sentences.zh: 哦，课程组织。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Er, clear?
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 嗯……清晰？

sentences.en: It was, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 确实很清晰，不是吗？

sentences.en: BEN: Yes, I think the organisation was clear
sentences.zh: BEN: 是的，我觉得课程组织安排得很清晰。

sentences.en: OK, anything else for course organisation?
sentences.zh: 好的，关于课程组织，还有别的要补充的吗？

sentences.en: ANNIE: It was a good thing he gave us the course outline at the beginning, in the first session, that was useful, so I'll put that down, shall I?
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 开课时他在第一节课就发给了我们课程大纲，这点很好，很有帮助，所以我得把这个写下来，可以吗？

sentences.en: Now, going on to suggestions for improvement, onc thing that wasn't so good, I think we could have done a bit more work at the beginning, I mean at the beginning it seemed dead easy
sentences.zh: 接下来是改进建议：有一件事不太理想，我觉得我们初期可以多安排些学习任务。我是说，刚开始时内容似乎特别简单。

sentences.en: BEN: Yeah
sentences.zh: BEN: 是啊。

sentences.en: ANNIE: I thought it was going to be really easy and then all of a sudden in the second half of the course we got a whole load of work, reading to do and essays and things
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 我当时还以为整门课都会很容易，结果到了课程后半段，突然一下子布置了大量任务——阅读材料、论文等等。

sentences.en: BEN: Yes, it'd be better if it was more even
sentences.zh: BEN: 是啊，如果任务量分布更均衡些会更好。

sentences.en: OK, now course delivery, does that mean teaching?
sentences.zh: 好的，现在看‘课程授课方式’，这指的是教学吗？

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yeah, I suppose so
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 嗯，我想应该是。

sentences.en: Well, what I thought was really good on this course was the standard of teaching
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这门课真正出色的地方在于教学质量。

sentences.en: Actually - mean some of the teachers were better than others - but the standard generally was fine
sentences.zh: 其实——我的意思是，有些老师比其他老师教得更好——但总体而言，教学质量还是不错的。

sentences.en: Much better than other courses I've been on
sentences.zh: 比我之前上过的其他课程要好得多。

sentences.en: BEN: Yeah, I agree
sentences.zh: BEN: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: Let's put that then
sentences.zh: 那我们就这么写吧。

sentences.en: What about suggestions for improvement?
sentences.zh: 关于教学方面的改进建议呢？

sentences.en: ANNIE: I
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 我……

sentences.en: I didn't think it was all that wonderful when we had great long group discussion sessions that went on for hours and hours
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些持续数小时之久的大型小组讨论环节并不太好。

sentences.en: I don't mean we shouldn't have group discussions, just that they shouldn't go on too long
sentences.zh: I并不是说我们不应该进行小组讨论，只是认为它们不应持续太长时间。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Now, on to materials and equipment
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 接下来谈谈教材和设备。

sentences.en: BEN: Oh, now what was good about some sessions was the handouts,
sentences.zh: BEN: 哦，有些课程的优点在于发放的讲义。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yes, I thought all the handouts were good actually, and some were great, with website addresses and everything
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 是的，实际上我觉得所有讲义都很好，其中一些尤其出色，还附有网站地址等信息。

sentences.en: BEN: One problem though with materials was the key texts
sentences.zh: BEN: 不过教材方面存在一个问题，即核心参考书目。

sentences.en: SL8
sentences.zh: 录音稿 SL8

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yes!
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 没错！

sentences.en: There just weren't enough copies on reserve in the library
sentences.zh: 图书馆预留的核心参考书数量严重不足。

sentences.en: And if you can't get the key texts before the session, how are you supposed to do the reading? C.com And not enough computers
sentences.zh: 如果你在上课前无法获取这些核心参考书，又怎能完成指定阅读任务？ C.com 而且电脑数量也不够。

sentences.en: You have to wait ages to get onc
sentences.zh: 你得等很久才能用上一台。

sentences.en: BEN: OK, testing and evaluation - well, I don't know, it's hard to say until we've got our written assignments back
sentences.zh: BEN: 好的，关于测试与评估——嗯，这很难说，毕竟我们还没拿回书面作业成绩。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Don't talk about it, I only got mine in yesterday, it was a real struggle
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 别提了，我昨天才刚拿到自己的作业，真是费尽周折。

sentences.en: I hate to think what mark I'll get
sentences.zh: 我真不敢想象自己会得多少分。

sentences.en: BEN: Yes, but at least we've done the oral presentation - thought that was good, the way I got my feedback really quickly
sentences.zh: BEN: 是啊，但至少我们已完成口头陈述——我觉得这部分不错，因为我很快就收到了反馈。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yes, it was
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And I liked the way we knew what we'd be evaluated on, we knew the criteria, so we knew we had to think about clarity, organisation, and so on
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢我们事先就清楚评估标准这一点，我们知道评分依据包括表达清晰度、结构组织性等等。

sentences.en: BEN: Yeah, but I'm not so sure about the written work
sentences.zh: BEN: 嗯，但我对书面作业部分不太确定。

sentences.en: One thing I think is that there's just too much, it's really stressful
sentences.zh: 我觉得作业量实在太大，压力真的很大。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yes, I'd agree and I don't see why they can't let us know the criteria they use for marking
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 是的，我同意；而且我不明白为什么他们不能提前告知我们评分标准。

sentences.en: BEN: The written assignments?
sentences.zh: BEN: 你是说书面作业吗？

sentences.en: But he told us
sentences.zh: 但他已经告诉过我们了。

sentences.en: ANNIE: No, for the final exams
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 不，我是指期末考试。

sentences.en: What are they looking for - what are the criteria?
sentences.zh: 他们究竟看重什么——评分标准是什么？

sentences.en: What makes a pass or a fail?
sentences.zh: 什么决定及格或不及格？

sentences.en: BEN: Yeah, I never thought of that
sentences.zh: BEN: 嗯，我之前还真没想过这个问题。

sentences.en: It'd be really useful
sentences.zh: 这确实会非常有用。

sentences.en: ANNIE: OK, any other comments?
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 好的，还有其他意见吗？

sentences.en: BEN: I thought student support was excellent
sentences.zh: BEN: 我觉得学生支持服务非常出色。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Yeah, me too
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 是的，我也这么认为。

sentences.en: OK, excellent
sentences.zh: 好的，非常棒。

sentences.en: Other comments?
sentences.zh: 还有其他意见吗？

sentences.en: BEN: No, I can't think of anything else
sentences.zh: BEN: 没有了，我想不出别的了。

sentences.en: ANNIE: Nor me
sentences.zh: ANNIE: 我也想不出别的了。

sentences.en: OK, so that's done
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这项工作就完成了。

sentences.en: Thanks, Ben
sentences.zh: 谢谢，Ben。

sentences.en: BEN: No, thank you
sentences.zh: BEN: 不，应该谢谢您。
